note: Weekly test (每周测验), 30 min, all four tracks. 事 si6 ×3 → Hard English recall (say aloud from the cue; leftover Hard only, then Wednesday's workplace recap) → Cantonese Hard + Wed recap + 3 new workplace lines → Japanese Hard kana (write once; no new) → Korean Friday Hard, recap Goods if time (no new) → 60-sec week wrap → 8-Q quiz. 先难后新。加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3, and not falling like 時 si4. Stay on it until three are clean.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls; 事 si6 sits low and flat)

tasks.prompt: Japanese: write each of these once, then say them aloud before flipping anything back. だ行 still waits — no new cards today.
tasks.script:
Write once, then say: ぎ gi · げ ge · やま yama (mountain) · よる yoru (night) · かぎ kagi (key) · ひがし higashi (east) · ざ za · じ ji · ず zu · ぜ ze · ぞ zo · かぜ kaze (wind) · じかん jikan (time) · あじ aji (taste).
Watch the two dakuten dots on が/ざ rows: か→が, さ→ざ, し→じ, せ→ぜ.

tasks.prompt: 60 seconds, workplace English: give a short end-of-week wrap. Point → reason → example. Say it aloud before opening the script.
tasks.script: This week I focused on getting used to the daily workflow. The reason is that I need to know where work usually gets stuck before I can help. For example, I'll recap what I finished, flag anything that may slip, and confirm what I'll pick up next week. If I've got something wrong, I'll check back early: just to confirm I've got this right.

questions.q: Tone number for 事 in 有咩事呀？
questions.explain: 事 si6, low flat. Not 試 si3 (mid) and not 時 si4 (falling).
面試 min6 si3. 事 si6 is the low flat one in 有咩事呀.

questions.q: Jyutping for 我傳咗俾你啦 (spaces between syllables).
answer: ngo5 cyun4 zo2 bei2 nei5 laa1
questions.explain: 我 ngo5 傳 cyun4 咗 zo2 俾 bei2 你 nei5 啦 laa1. This was Wednesday's Hard line.

questions.q: Best way to flag a delay at work?
options: “I want to flag early that this may slip to Thursday.”
a task you have already finished
what you are expected to do in a particular social situation
questions.explain: the done thing = the expected custom. A mare is the unpleasant experience; miffed is slightly annoyed.
さ sa → ざ za with two dots.
じ ji · か ka · ん n → jikan (time).

questions.q: How do you say “six, please” with 개?
options: 여섯 개 주세요 (여섯 stays the same)
questions.explain: From 다섯 onward the native number stays the same before 개. ㅅ at the bottom of 섯 still sounds as t: yeoseot. 영수증 주세요 is “the receipt, please.”
